# Parse the note content to extract song titles and artists.
content = note['content']
lines = content.strip().split('\n')
# First line is the heading, skip it
song_lines = lines[1:]
songs = []
for line in song_lines:
    line = line.strip()
    if not line:
        continue
    # Split on " by " to get title and artist part
    if ' by ' in line:
        title, artist_part = line.split(' by ', 1)
        songs.append({'title': title.strip(), 'artist': artist_part.strip()})
    else:
        songs.append({'title': line, 'artist': ''})
print(songs)
